extract_archive_with_manager: use ExtractManager to extract a compressed archive file to a cached output directory
extract_archive_with_format: use Extractor.extract to extract an archive to a given output path with a specified format
infer_extractor_format: use Extractor.infer_extractor_format to detect the archive format of a file by reading its magic number
check_if_extractable: use Extractor.is_extractable to check whether a given file path is a supported extractable archive
filter_safe_tar_members: use TarExtractor.safemembers to filter tar archive members and block directory traversal attacks
